user.title: Add My Passwords
user.description: The master password is set in your browser when you first open the panel; Home Assistant never stores it and it cannot be recovered if lost. Current device UUID: {uuid} Copy and keep this UUID separately from your HA backups. You will need it to rebind the vault after reinstalling Home Assistant or restoring only the vault file.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single configuration is allowed
